deadline.value: January 1 for Fall 2027, international and Canadian applicants.
deadline.quote: Application Deadline - International | FALL September 15 January 1 January 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required, but is highly recommended.

supervisor.value: Admission depends on a professor agreeing to supervise you, though you need not name one when you apply; contacting faculty is recommended.
supervisor.quote: Admission to the PhD program is contingent upon a faculty member agreeing to supervise the research to be performed by an applicant.

also.quote: The identification of a prospective research supervisor is not mandatory at the application stage.

funding.value: Support comes from TA posts (most but not all students), supervisor grants and merit fellowships such as MEDA; no guarantee is stated.
funding.quote: A majority, but not all, full-time graduate students can be offered a Teaching Assistantship. | Fellowships of $22,000 to $25,000 a year for 3 years, for high caliber PhD students (MEDA)

entry_route.value: PhD applicants are expected to hold a master's (one reference must come from your master's supervisor).
entry_route.quote: This applies to the Bachelor's degree as well as to the Master's degree for PhD applicants. | For PhD applicants, one letter must be from your Master's supervisor.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 94 with at least 20 in each section.
toefl_min.quote: a minimum TOEFL score on the iBT (internet based test) of 94 overall and no less than 20 in each of the four component areas

ielts_min.value: IELTS 7.0 overall with at least 6.0 in each band.
ielts_min.quote: a minimum band score of 7 or greater (Academic module) and no less than 6.0 for each of listening, reading, writing and speaking
